description: This file defines the class Well19937c, which implements a specific pseudo-random number generator based on the WELL algorithm. It includes constructors for various seed types and an overridden method to generate random bits using the implementation of the algorithm.

classes.name: Well19937c
classes.description: A class implementing the WELL19937c pseudo-random number generator, extending AbstractWell, with methods for different seeding options and internal state management.

methods.name: Well19937c
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the generator, with options for time-based, int seed, int array seed, or long seed.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Generates the next random number bits based on the internal state, implementing the WELL19937c algorithm's core computation.
